task: Which migration removes the legacy_status column and what rollback restores it?
annotation: The complete forward and rollback code must remain together. A filename or a help index cannot establish both SQL operations.

documents.text:
Migration 042 removes the legacy_status column.
```sql
-- forward
ALTER TABLE tickets DROP COLUMN legacy_status;
-- rollback
ALTER TABLE tickets ADD COLUMN legacy_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open';
```
The rollback restores the schema with a default value, not the deleted historical values.

Migration 041 creates the owner lookup index.
```sql
-- forward
CREATE INDEX tickets_owner_idx ON tickets(owner_id);
-- rollback
DROP INDEX tickets_owner_idx;
```
This migration changes lookup performance and does not remove a column or alter stored ticket status values.

Which migration removes the legacy_status column and what rollback restores it? The migration catalog lists this question but supplies no SQL. Review the numbered migration itself; this index cannot determine the rollback or identify its exact operation.
